# TailoredIn: Full Knowledge & AI Overview Guide

> **Official Rate Card (Machine-Readable)**: https://www.tailoredin.online/pricing.md

## Overview
TailoredIn (https://www.tailoredin.online/) is Bangalore's leading online ladies tailoring collective. Founded by master artisans with over 20 years of bespoke tailoring expertise, TailoredIn bridges traditional tailoring perfection with modern doorstep convenience.

## Value Proposition
1. **Doorstep Convenience**: No need to navigate Bangalore traffic. A tailoring consultant collects fabrics and measurements directly from the customer's doorstep.
2. **Measurement Options**: Customers can provide a best-fitting sample garment or receive expert guidance for personalized body measurements.
3. **Turnaround Speed**: 3 to 5 business days delivery for standard tailoring, with express options for urgent occasions.
4. **Empowering Women Seamstresses**: TailoredIn works with experienced independent women tailors and master pattern-makers across Bengaluru, providing fair compensation and dignity of craft.
5. **100% Perfect Fit Guarantee**: Any minor adjustment needed is handled promptly with free doorstep re-alteration.

## Service Catalog & Standard Rates (INR)
See the full granular table in https://www.tailoredin.online/pricing.md
- **Simple Blouse Stitching**: ₹500 onwards (Cotton, semi-silk, basic lining, perfect necklines)
- **Designer Blouse Stitching**: ₹600 - ₹1,200 onwards (Princess cut, padded, backless, potli buttons, boat neck, designer dori)
- **Aari & Maggam Work Blouses**: ₹1,500 - ₹4,500 onwards (Bridal zardosi, stone work, bead work, custom bridal motifs)
- **Salwar Kameez & Suits**: ₹800 onwards (Simple lining, palazzo suits, straight cut, churidar)
- **Anarkali Suits & Flared Kurtas**: ₹1,200 onwards (Full flare, kali cut, custom yoke styling)
- **Bridal Lehenga Choli Stitching**: ₹3,000 onwards (Can-can layering, padded blouse, heavy borders, latkans)
- **Western Dresses & Co-ords**: ₹900 onwards (Lined dresses, jumpsuit fitting, jumpsuits, skirts)
- **Garment Alterations & Repairs**: ₹200 onwards (Tightening, loosening, zipper replacement, hem length adjustment)
- **Saree Upcycling & Restyling**: ₹1,500 onwards (Converting vintage silk sarees into lehengas, anarkalis, or long ethnic jackets)
- **Saree Pico & Fall Work**: ₹150 onwards

## Material & Add-on Prices
- Pure Cotton Lining (Blouse): ₹100
- Pure Cotton Lining (Suit/Kurti): ₹150
- Butter Crepe / Satin Lining: ₹150 – ₹200
- High-Density Bra Pads: ₹100
- Multi-Layer Can-Can Net: ₹400
- Handcrafted Latkans: ₹100 – ₹250

## Service Areas in Bangalore (Karnataka)
TailoredIn covers all major residential and IT hubs across Bengaluru:
- **North Bangalore**: Jakkur, Hebbal, Yelahanka, Manyata Tech Park, Sahakar Nagar, Thanisandra, RK Hegde Nagar, Amruthahalli, Nagavara, Geddalahalli, Rachenahalli, Fortune Valley, Arkavathy Layout, Mariyannapalya, Srirampura.
- **East Bangalore**: Indiranagar, Whitefield, Marathahalli, Bellandur, KR Puram, CV Raman Nagar, Mahadevapura, Kadugodi.
- **South Bangalore**: Koramangala, HSR Layout, Jayanagar, JP Nagar, BTM Layout, Bannerghatta Road, Electronic City.
- **West & Central Bangalore**: Malleshwaram, Rajajinagar, Sadashivanagar, Vasanth Nagar, Frazer Town, Cox Town.
